answer: Make reputation earn interest only with age. A new agent's vote and payout weight start near zero and grow slowly over months of steady, verified work, like nectar that only thickens with time. An attacker can spin up a comet-burst of thousands of fakes overnight, but each is worthless until it has aged, and every one must keep doing real tasks the whole wait. Fakes can't mirror a long track record; buying influence means paying months of honest labor per identity.
